verses.a: Blessed be the Lord the God of Israel,
verses.b: who has come to his people and set them free.

verses.a: He has raised up for us a mighty Saviour,
verses.b: born of the house of his servant David.

verses.a: Through his holy prophets God promised of old
verses.b: to save us from our enemies, from the hands of all that hate us,

verses.a: To show mercy to our ancestors,
verses.b: and to remember his holy covenant.

verses.a: This was the oath God swore to our father Abraham:
verses.b: to set us free from the hands of our enemies,

verses.a: Free to worship him without fear,
verses.b: holy and righteous in his sight all the days of our life.

verses.a: And you, child, shall be called the prophet of the Most High,
verses.b: for you will go before the Lord to prepare his way,

verses.a: To give his people knowledge of salvation
verses.b: by the forgiveness of all their sins.

verses.a: In the tender compassion of our God
verses.b: the dawn from on high shall break upon us,

verses.a: To shine on those who dwell in darkness and the shadow of death,
verses.b: and to guide our feet into the way of peace.

verses.a: Glory to the Father and to the Son and to the Holy Spirit; as it was in the beginning is now and shall be for ever. Amen.
My soul proclaims the greatness of the Lord, my spirit rejoices in God my Saviour;
verses.b: he has looked with favour on his lowly servant.

verses.a: From this day all generations will call me blessed;
verses.b: the Almighty has done great things for me and holy is his name.

verses.a: He has mercy on those who fear him,
verses.b: from generation to generation.

verses.a: He has shown strength with his arm
verses.b: and has scattered the proud in their conceit,

verses.a: Casting down the mighty from their thrones
verses.b: and lifting up the lowly.

verses.a: He has filled the hungry with good things
verses.b: and sent the rich away empty.

verses.a: He has come to the aid of his servant Israel,
verses.b: to remember his promise of mercy,

verses.a: The promise made to our ancestors,
verses.b: to Abraham and his children for ever.

verses.a: Glory to the Father and to the Son and to the Holy Spirit; as it was in the beginning is now and shall be for ever. Amen.
Now, Lord, you let your servant go in peace:
verses.b: your word has been fulfilled.

verses.a: My own eyes have seen the salvation
verses.b: which you have prepared in the sight of every people;

verses.a: A light to reveal you to the nations
verses.b: and the glory of your people Israel.

verses.a: Glory to the Father and to the Son and to the Holy Spirit; as it was in the beginning is now and shall be for ever. Amen.
Christ Jesus was in the form of God,
verses.b: but he did not cling to equality with God.

verses.a: He emptied himself, taking the form of a servant,
verses.b: and was born in our human likeness.

verses.a: Being found in human form he humbled himself,
verses.b: and became obedient unto death, even death on a cross.

verses.a: Therefore God has highly exalted him,
verses.b: and bestowed on him the name above every name,

verses.a: That at the name of Jesus, every knee should bow,
verses.b: in heaven and on earth and under the earth;

verses.a: And every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord,
verses.b: to the glory of God the Father.

verses.a: Glory to the Father and to the Son and to the Holy Spirit; as it was in the beginning is now and shall be for ever. Amen.
Great and wonderful are your deeds,
verses.b: Lord God the Almighty.

verses.a: Just and true are your ways,
verses.b: O ruler of the nations.

verses.a: Who shall not revere and praise your name, O Lord?
verses.b: for you alone are holy.

verses.a: All nations shall come and worship in your presence:
verses.b: for your just dealings have been revealed.

verses.a: To the One who sits on the throne and to the Lamb
verses.b: be blessing and honour and glory and might, for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.a: Blessed are you, the God of our ancestors,
verses.b: worthy to be praised and exalted for ever.

verses.a: Blessed is your holy and glorious name,
verses.b: worthy to be praised and exalted for ever.

verses.a: Blessed are you, in your holy and glorious temple,
verses.b: worthy to be praised and exalted for ever.

verses.a: Blessed are you who look into the depths,
verses.b: worthy to be praised and exalted for ever.

verses.a: Blessed are you, enthroned on the cherubim,
verses.b: worthy to be praised and exalted for ever.

verses.a: Blessed are you on the throne of your kingdom,
verses.b: worthy to be praised and exalted for ever.

verses.a: Blessed are you in the heights of heaven,
verses.b: worthy to be praised and exalted for ever.

verses.a: Bless the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit, worthy to be praised and exalted for ever.
Jesus, Saviour of the world, come to us in your mercy:
verses.b: we look to you to save and help us.

verses.a: By your cross and your life laid down, you set your people free:
verses.b: we look to you to save and help us.

verses.a: When they were ready to perish, you saved your disciples:
verses.b: we look to you to come to our help.

verses.a: In the greatness of your mercy, loose us from our chains,
verses.b: forgive the sins of all your people.

verses.a: Make yourself known as our Saviour and mighty deliverer;
verses.b: save and help us that we may praise you.

verses.a: Come now and dwell with us, Lord Christ Jesus:
verses.b: hear our prayer and be with us always.

verses.a: And when you come in your glory:
verses.b: make us to be one with you and to share the life of your kingdom.

verses.a: We praise you, O God,
we acclaim you as the Lord;
all creation worships you,
the Father everlasting.
To you all angels, all the powers of heaven,
the cherubim and seraphim, sing in endless praise:
Holy, holy, holy Lord, God of power and might,
heaven and earth are full of your glory.
The glorious company of apostles praise you.
The noble fellowship of prophets praise you.
The white-robed army of martyrs praise you.
Throughout the world the holy Church acclaims you:
Father, of majesty unbounded,
your true and only Son, worthy of all praise,
the Holy Spirit, advocate and guide.
You, Christ, are the King of glory,
the eternal Son of the Father.
When you took our flesh to set us free
you humbly chose the Virgin's womb.
You overcame the sting of death
and opened the kingdom of heaven to all believers.
You are seated at God's right hand in glory.
We believe that you will come and be our judge.
Come then, Lord, and help your people,
bought with the price of your own blood,
and bring us with your saints
to glory everlasting.
Save your people, Lord, and bless your inheritance.
Govern and uphold them now and always.
Day by day we bless you.
We praise your name for ever.
Keep us today, Lord, from all sin.
Have mercy on us, Lord, have mercy.
Lord, show us your love and mercy,
for we have put our trust in you.
In you, Lord, is our hope:
let us never be put to shame.
O come, let us sing to the Lord;
verses.b: let us heartily rejoice in the rock of our salvation.

verses.a: Let us come into his presence with thanksgiving
verses.b: and be glad in him with psalms.

verses.a: For the Lord is a great God
verses.b: and a great king above all gods.

verses.a: In his hand are the depths of the earth
verses.b: and the heights of the mountains are his also.

verses.a: The sea is his, for he made it,
verses.b: and his hands have moulded the dry land.

verses.a: Come, let us worship and bow down
verses.b: and kneel before the Lord our Maker.

verses.a: For he is our God;
verses.b: we are the people of his pasture and the sheep of his hand.

verses.a: O that today you would listen to his voice:
verses.b: 'Harden not your hearts as at Meribah, on that day at Massah in the wilderness,

verses.a: 'When your forebears tested me, and put me to the proof,
verses.b: though they had seen my works.

verses.a: 'Forty years long I detested that generation and said,
verses.b: "This people are wayward in their hearts; they do not know my ways."

verses.a: 'So I swore in my wrath,
verses.b: "They shall not enter into my rest." '

verses.a: Glory to the Father and to the Son and to the Holy Spirit; as it was in the beginning is now and shall be for ever. Amen.
Christ our passover has been sacrificed for us:
verses.b: so let us celebrate the feast,

verses.a: not with the old leaven of corruption and wickedness:
verses.b: but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

verses.a: Christ once raised from the dead dies no more:
verses.b: death has no more dominion over him.

verses.a: In dying he died to sin once for all:
verses.b: in living he lives to God.

verses.a: See yourselves therefore as dead to sin:
verses.b: and alive to God in Jesus Christ our Lord.

verses.a: Christ has been raised from the dead:
verses.b: the first fruits of those who sleep.

verses.a: For as by man came death:
verses.b: by man has come also the resurrection of the dead;

verses.a: for as in Adam all die:
verses.b: even so in Christ shall all be made alive.

verses.a: Glory to the Father and to the Son and to the Holy Spirit; as it was in the beginning is now and shall be for ever. Amen.
O be joyful in the Lord, all the earth;
verses.b: serve the Lord with gladness and come before his presence with a song.

verses.a: Know that the Lord is God;
verses.b: it is he that has made us and we are his; we are his people and the sheep of his pasture.

verses.a: Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise;
verses.b: give thanks to him and bless his name.

verses.a: For the Lord is gracious; his steadfast love is everlasting,
verses.b: and his faithfulness endures from generation to generation.

verses.a: Glory to the Father and to the Son and to the Holy Spirit; as it was in the beginning is now and shall be for ever. Amen.

phos_hilaron.title: Phos hilaron - a Song of the Light

verses.a: O joyful light,
from the pure glory of the eternal heavenly Father,
O holy, blessed Jesus Christ.
As we come to the setting of the sun
and see the evening light,
we give thanks and praise to the Father and to the Son
and to the Holy Spirit of God.
Worthy are you at all times
to be sung with holy voices,
O Son of God, O giver of life,
and to be glorified through all creation.
Let my prayer rise before you as incense,
the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.
O Lord, I call to you; come to me quickly;
hear my voice when I cry to you.
Set a watch before my mouth, O Lord,
and guard the door of my lips;
Let my prayer rise before you as incense,
the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.
Let not my heart incline to any evil thing;
let me not be occupied in wickedness with evildoers.
But my eyes are turned to you, Lord God;
in you I take refuge; do not leave me defenceless.
Let my prayer rise before you as incense,
the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.
Bless the Lord, O my soul.
O Lord my God, how excellent is your greatness!
You are clothed with majesty and honour,
wrapped in light as in a garment.
The sun knows the time for its setting.
You make darkness that it may be night.
Bless the Lord, O my soul.
O Lord my God, how excellent is your greatness!
O Lord, how manifold are your works!
In wisdom you have made them all;
the earth is full of your creatures.
When you send forth your spirit, they are created,
and you renew the face of the earth.
Bless the Lord, O my soul.
O Lord my God, how excellent is your greatness!
May the glory of the Lord endure for ever;
may the Lord rejoice in his works;
I will sing to the Lord as long as I live;
I will make music to my God while I have my being.
Bless the Lord, O my soul.
O Lord my God, how excellent is your greatness!
